title: Back to the Future
blurb: A time-travel trilogy where release order and story order match perfectly, despite visiting 1885, 1955, 1985 and 2015.

b89.t: Back to the Future Part II

b90.t: Back to the Future Part III

note: Parts II and III were filmed back to back and Part II ends mid-story, so they are best watched in one sitting. Sorting by the years visited would make nonsense of the plot.
